objects.original: A1.E1/E2 actual iid Exp1 wait and post-bounce initial phase; Ex1-3 literal rate/flow/S. A7 jump density factor.
objects.reconstructed: Concrete P,epsilon,c,Phi,S,rate,Lambda,tau; U,F,A,d,rho,J are explicit finite first-event and post-bounce law adapters.
objects.evidence: All fourteen definitions audited. Eight literal objects agree with source; finite law/marked measure packaging is attributed ASTIS completion.

domains.original: Real Euclidean full phase, fixed y/reference/z, finite nonnegative horizon; bounded measurable path tests in A7.
domains.reconstructed: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E, fixed y,xRef,z; T:NNReal; Borel real h on NNReal×(E×E), real M>=0 globally bounding |h|.
domains.evidence: Coordinate-free/rank0 packaging is explicit. Real s is restricted to Ioc(0,T); d/J negative-time extensions cannot change the law.

quantifiers.original: Fixed parameters, initial phase, finite horizon, independent actual clocks; no uniform exceptional set across arbitrary states.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Six source binders before literal definitions; forall fixed y,xRef,z, measurability outputs; forall T; forall h measurable; forall M>=0 and global bound, three L1 and integral outputs.
quantifiers.evidence: No random-initial-state substitution, no all-parameters uniform AE claim. Tests have standard bounded-Borel class binders rather than extra dynamics assumptions.

assumptions.original: 0<alpha<=beta, C2V, global Hessian sandwich, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.
assumptions.reconstructed: Exactly hAlpha,hAlphaBeta,hV,hH,hEta,hBetaEta with finite-dimensional Borel real phase infrastructure.
assumptions.evidence: No supplied hazard regularity, measured process, clock marginal, normalizer, invariance, positivity of rate/cap, inverse strictness, tail conditioning or path-law premise.

conclusion.original: A7 includes finite event density lambda(Phi_s z)exp(-Lambda_z(s)); A2 supplies its actual post-bounce mark.
conclusion.reconstructed: Meas U,F,J and A; finite restricted waiting law=rho; marked law=map J rho; finite rho, real mass=1-exp(-Lambda T), mass<=1; three integrability claims and exact bounded marked integral identity.
conclusion.evidence: This supplies first-event density, not just existing CDF/tail or measurability wrapper. It does not assert n-event path weights or full A7.

scopes.original: Complete A7/A8/invariance/L2 needs further conditional iteration, path conventions, change of variables, rho-survival identity, summability and contraction/density.
scopes.reconstructed: Doc explicitly leaves full path law, unused-tail conditioning, reversal, invariance, semigroup/allL2, errors/cost/main/composition OPEN.
scopes.evidence: Whole private Prop has no those conclusions. Zero/infinite waits and zero normal are retained. Source failed terminal limit0 versus later actual fallback convention is not used here to assert a stronger path law.

constant_dependencies.original: Hazard weight exp(-Lambda), rate sqrt eta max0, original beta*eta<=1; bounded functional norm.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Exact unit Exp scale1, original eta scaling, no renormalizer; M>=0 is an arbitrary test bound. T is any finite NNReal and rho mass≤1.
constant_dependencies.evidence: No division by rate/cap or by event probability; no new uniform exponential envelope or integrability premise. Three L1 outputs must be derived from finite event mass and bounded tests.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: P
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition: let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Literal countable independent expMeasure1 product, not supplied law. Concrete probability and coordinate marginal must be derived with existing UnitExponentialProduct, not assumed.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: ε
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition: let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: toNNReal(sample k); coordinate0 is source E1. It equals positive real coordinate AE under actual product; invalid negative/zero samples may map0, which A excludes.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: c
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition: let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: Φ
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Exact actual real-time harmonic formula with sqrt eta momentum scale and -sin/sqrt eta velocity term.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: S
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Actual position-fixed orthogonal reflection. Total real division gives zero correction at zero normal, hence source R0=I. Borel, no continuity demanded.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: rate
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: sqrt eta * max 0 <p,grad V(x)-grad V(xRef)>, source Ex1, continuous nonnegative.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: Λ
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Actual interval integral 0..t along actual Phi; NNReal horizon and source C1 derivative derived, not extra hypothesis.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: τ
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Actual hittingAfter of Lambda-e at Ici0 starting0, equivalent to source inf threshold and empty top under the existing actual clock contract.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: U
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let U : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z sample => τ y xRef z (ε sample 0)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Literal actual first waiting time tau evaluated at epsilon coordinate0, WithTop NNReal. No abstract event/process supplied.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: F
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let F : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef z sample => ((U y xRef z sample).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Real coercion of untopD0. Used only under A where U is positive and bounded by finite T, so top/default0 cannot create a false marked event.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: A
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: 0<U and U≤finite T. Measurable restriction keeps first finite positive event; missing mass includes U>T or top. Null zero threshold removed explicitly.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: d
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let d : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ → ℝ := fun y xRef z s =>
      rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z) * Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z (Real.toNNReal s))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: rate(Phi_s z)*exp(-Lambda_z(toNNReal s)); nonnegative continuous on finite positive interval. Negative s extension has no effect on restricted density.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: ρ
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let ρ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → Measure ℝ := fun y xRef z T =>
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))).withDensity
        (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (d y xRef z s))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: Lebesgue restricted Ioc(0,T), with ENNReal.ofReal(d) density. Unnormalized finite subprobability, mass 1-exp(-Lambda(T)), with no division by event probability.

literal_and_derived_object_audit.name: J
literal_and_derived_object_audit.definition:
let J : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ → (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) :=
      fun y xRef z s => (Real.toNNReal s, S xRef (Φ y xRef s z))
literal_and_derived_object_audit.assessment: (toNNReal s,S(Phi_s z)), exactly event time plus actual post-bounce phase from initial T0=0 in A2. Global Borel real-time extension; only positive finite s consumed.

boundary_cases.T0: A empty and rho zero; all three L1 and zero integral valid.
boundary_cases.rank0: rate zero; positive thresholds wait top, no finite event mass.
boundary_cases.zero_normal: Total reflection is identity; no extra assumption excludes it.
boundary_cases.flat_hazard: CDF/FTC route does not invert a strictly monotone hazard; density zero on flat arcs.
boundary_cases.infinite_wait: U=top excluded by U≤finite T; F default0 cannot generate J(0) false event.
boundary_cases.threshold0_or_negative_raw_input: epsilon=0 can yield U0; A positive restriction removes it, consistent with actual Exp1 null exception.
boundary_cases.M0: Zero test; no positive M required.
boundary_cases.endpointT: Finite event at exactly T allowed by Ioc/A≤T, source strict simplex endpoint ambiguity avoided; nonatomic derived density makes later strict endpoint adaptation possible.
boundary_cases.fixed_params: No uniform all-parameter AE event or arbitrary correlated random initial state substitution.

truth_boundary: Bounded first-event density plus post-bounce marked law is a genuine next producer for A7, not full A7, a process Markov theorem, invariance, or allL2. Assumptions/actual inputs unchanged; source implicit first-factor proof is explicit ASTIS completion. This is not proof acceptance or VERIFIED.
